name: Desigual

prices.note: All 160 tiles of the US women's dresses listing (8 pages, ?start=0..140&sz=20; tile JSON price.sales with price.list null = regular). 116 regular-price dresses after dropping 39 marked down (price.list set) and 5 non-dresses (4 jumpsuits, 1 'lace V-neck T-shirt'). Low: vintage printed mini dresses $119; high: Long multiposition Ottolinger dress $699, next Detachable cargo jumpsuit excluded; median $169; 92 of 116 at $199 or less. Lines: 16 M. C. Lacroix dresses $119–$219 (e.g. Dress Designed By mr. christian lacroix $169), 9 Ottolinger collab dresses $199–$699 (Ottolinger Long Dress $199).

notes: 2026-10-29 (brands-like-desigual run): US store (desigual.com/en_US, Salesforce Commerce Cloud; answers the StylodexBot UA, prices in USD). Shopping guide + FAQ: 'Free shipping when you spend $80 or more'; standard delivery 4–10 working days; delivery point or home; excludes Puerto Rico and APO/FPO. Cost under $80 and duties not stated, so the copy doesn't quote them.

Returns page: 'You have 30 calendar days to return your purchases from the date you receive your order'; listed under 'Free returns' with home pickup; underwear, swimwear and jewelry only with seal intact; returns from different orders can't be grouped.
Woman size guide: tops/dresses US XXS–XL (= EU XS–XXL, ES 36–46); pants/skirts/jeans US 6–16. No plus, petite or tall ranges listed.

About us: 'Thomas Meyer created Desigual in 1984, in the Barcelona neighbourhood of El Raval'; first piece an upcycled jacket; '+215 Stores', 'Present in 107 Countries'. Organization JSON-LD knowsAbout: Vestidos, Estampados, bolsos coloridos; dresses meta: 'Get an original and atypical style'. known_for 'Original Prints' built from these.
Separate en_CA (CAD), en_AU (AUD) and en_GB (GBP) stores list dresses, so ships_to US, CA, GB, AU. No US store locator found (/en_US/stores/ redirects to /woman/), so us_stores empty.

Category counts on the US store (unique tiles): bags 256, women's T-shirts 183, dresses 160, coats & jackets 138, jumpers 106, shirts & tops 60. Best-sellers (105): dress is the most common product word, so dresses is the hero line used as C.
